h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ghaziabad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ghaziabad

c: High-rise societies in Ghaziabad, from Indirapuram to Raj Nagar Extension, often have their open space on a podium above the parking. Grouting machines into a podium slab is usually not possible, and that changes how an outdoor gym is planned. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to these societies, as well as to schools, colleges and municipal parks in Ghaziabad. Every machine is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,130 km away.

For podium sites, we use self-standing bases that sit on the surface without cutting into the waterproofing below. Your society's structural consultant should confirm the load. For ground-level parks, we grout the bases into the soil. In both cases our installation team or a dealer in the NCR installs the machines after you approve a layout drawing with the clear space marked.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on a podium without drilling?
items.a: Yes. We use self-standing bases for podium sites, so the waterproofing stays intact. Your structural consultant should check the load on the slab before we finalise the layout.

items.q: Do you supply rubber flooring for a podium gym?
items.a: Yes. Rubber flooring cushions the area under and around the machines and protects the podium finish. We can supply it along with the gym equipment.

items.q: Which societies in Ghaziabad do you supply?
items.a: We supply any society, school or park in Ghaziabad that sends us its site details. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our team or a dealer in the NCR.
